[[File:Atha'an Miere.JPG|thumb|250px]]'''Wavemistress''' is the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' title for the leader of a Sea Folk Clan.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wavemistress}} The Wavemistress of a clan is also the [[Sailmistress]] of her own ship.

The Wavemistress usually appoints her [[Cargomaster]] to become [[Swordmaster]] for her, and one of her [[Windfinder]]s as her personal advisor.

A Wavemistress can be recognized by the large number of medallions on her nose-ring. Often, they number so greatly that there is no space in between each one.

==Known Wavemistresses==

*[[Zaida din Parede Blackwing]] - former Wavemistress of Clan [[Catelar]], now [[Mistress of the Ships]].
*[[Malin din Toral Breaking Wave]] - Wavemistress of Clan [[Somarin]] and Sailmistress of ''[[Windrunner]]''.
*[[Niolle din Lembar]] - Wavemistress (clan unknown).
*[[Wallein din Onill]] - Wavemistress (clan unknown).
*[[Lincora din Omen]] - Wavemistress (clan unknown).
*[[Pelanna]] - Wavemistress of Clan Kisagi.
*[[Lacine]] - Wavemistress (clan unknown).
*[[Harine din Togara Two Winds]] - Wavemistress of Clan [[Shodein]] (second least senior of the First Twelve).
*[[Mareil]] - Wavemistress of Clan Mushien (least senior of the First Twelve).

There is an additional Clan called [[Takana]] whose Wavemistress must be one of the above women.
